messages:
Nina Park: Hey all — newbie question: where should I put my first-week notes and who should I grant edit access to? I spun up a page under my personal space but want to follow team norms.
Tom Becker: Welcome Nina! :wave: We usually duplicate the 'Ramp Notes' template from DevEx and keep it private for a few days. Then move to Platform / Onboarding / New Hires / 2026 once it's ready to share.
Grace Huang: Add your manager + buddy as editors when you move it. If you want the page to live in the team folder immediately, fill the Docs Access form and pick the destination folder — DevEx will apply the ACLs.
Nina Park: Which template do folks use? There are a couple in the DevEx templates area.
Tom Becker: Use the 'Ramp Notes (single)' template. It has the 7-day checklist and #ramp-goals block. Link: https://notion.redwood/devex/templates/ramp-notes-single
Docs Bot: Automated: Received access request for Platform / Onboarding / New Hires / 2026. Ticket DOC-4999. Expected ACL update within 24 hours.
Kofi Mensah: Also pro tip: name the page like "2026-03 Nina Park - Ramp Notes" so it's easy to filter by year. We prefer not to keep lots of personal pages in the shared folder until they're ready to be public.
Nina Park: Perfect — I'll duplicate the template, add my manager + Kofi as editors, and submit the form. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Tom Becker: If you want me to drop the team kickoff checklist into the page after you move it, DM me the link and I'll add it.
